$comment: Declarative gate registry for the golden-path corpus. Adding a gate is an entry here,
not a new script. Run `node scripts/census/run-census.mjs --help` for the contract.
id           stable slug; also the --rule filter value
goldenPath   the doc that owns this rule. A rule with no owner is a rule nobody maintains.
pattern is matched against WHOLE FILE CONTENT, never line-by-line
exclude      [{ path, reason }] — reason is REQUIRED and enforced (>= 12 chars).
An exclude that matches no file fails the run (stale exemption).
baseline     { files, matches } — the run fails if either RISES, and also if either
DROPS without this being updated (a silent drop is usually a broken matcher)
floor        minimum files the walk must SEE. Below it, the result is untrustworthy
and the run fails with 'matcher broken, not codebase clean'.
